title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Late-Placement Retention on Loan-Event Credits
content:
Under the **Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs** loan-event schedule, a certificate that was issued well after the date its coverage started keeps part of its loan-event credit with Tidemark.

**Late-placement retention.** Tidemark keeps, without taking the loan-event credit below zero, 150 dollars of it when the certificate's issue entry was processed more than 60 days after the start date shown on that issue entry, 75 dollars when it was processed 31 to 60 days after that date, and nothing when it was processed 30 days or fewer after that date.

Both dates come from the issue entry: its processing date and the coverage start it shows (which may be the lapse date). Days between two dates are counted from the earlier date to the later date, the earlier date excluded and the later date included.

| Issue entry processed, after the start date on it | Kept |
|---|---|
| 30 days or fewer | Nothing |
| 31 to 60 days | 75 dollars |
| More than 60 days | 150 dollars |

*Hypothetical:* coverage start 2 January on the issue entry, processed 3 March of a non-leap year — 60 days, 75 dollars kept; processed 4 March — 61 days, 150 dollars kept.
